name: Awesome-CUA
tagline: A catalog of computer-use agent research and resources
description: Awesome CUA (Awesome Computer-Use Agents) is an online catalog that indexes research and resources related to computer-use agents. It lists over 5,300 reviewed records, including papers, benchmarks, datasets, models, and tools. Each entry is checked against its primary source and includes evidence links. The catalog data is openly available for download in JSONL or SQLite formats, allowing researchers and developers to pull the information into notebooks, retrieval indexes, or custom agents. The site also provides a search interface to explore the records.
best_for: Getting lists of models for agent research
Integrating catalog data into custom tools
